Name: Farmhouse Doors
Author: waterice888
Description:
[b]What does this mod do[/b]
Added three doors to the vanilla game(door1, door2, door3) as the main file.
Each door can be individually selected to appear or not, with 3 options for appearance (light/window/salon) and 2 options for type (automatic/manual switch).

Add a window door to the bathroom mod as an optional file. I only uploaded the map file to add the door. The recolour file of the bathroom is not include, because it is edited for my personal use.

The doors added in this mod only block the player and do not affect the path of the spouse or children.

[b]What does this mod not do[/b]
The reason why I didn't add a door on the left side of the room in the upper right corner is because it is 2 grids lengthwise, and the prior mod Better Doors does not allow for adding horizontal double doors.
The reason why I didn't add a door above the room in the lower right corner is that it is horizontal 3 grids. There is no horizontal 3 grids door in Stardew Valley.
The reason why I didn't add a door in the middle of the living room partition is that building or removing the partition would produce visual errors. I haven't found a solution yet.

[b]Note[/b]
[b]Please use unofficial updates for both the prior mod and the bathroom mod![/b]
the prior mod Better Doors：
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3797]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3797[/url]
its unofficial version：
[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-60#post-41713]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-60#post-41713[/url]
(You can set DoorToggleRadius and SilenceAutomaticDoors in the Better Doors config file, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3797]Better Doors[/url]' mod introduction)

Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade：
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299[/url]
its unofficial version：
[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-89#post-58559]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-89#post-58559
[/url]﻿
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

向原游戏中添加3道门（door1、door2和door3）作为主文件。
每道门可以单独选择是否出现，其外观有3种可选方案（木板门/带窗门/沙龙门），类型有两种可选方案（自动开关/手动开关）。
向浴室模组添加带窗门，作为可选文件。我只上传了增加门的地图文件，并不包含美化文件（因为美化是编辑以供个人使用的）。

本模组添加的门只对玩家有阻拦效果，并不阻挡配偶和孩子。

之所以没有在右上角房间的左侧添加门，是因为这是纵向2格的，前置模组Better Doors不允许添加横向双开门。
之所以没有在右下角房间的上方添加门，是因为这是横向3格的，星露谷没有横向3格的门。
之所以没有在客厅中部隔断添加门，是因为建造隔断或拆除隔断会产生视觉错误，目前我还没有找到完美的解决方案。

注意：前置模组和浴室模组都需要使用非官方更新版本！
前置模组Better Doors：
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3797]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3797[/url]
其非官方更新版本：
[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-60#post-41713]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-60#post-41713[/url]
（你可以在Better Doors的配置文件中设置开关门半径、静音自动门）

浴室模组Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade：
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299[/url]
其非官方更新版本：
